title: Pi session storage can be relocated outside the project without committing a path
statement: On pi 0.84.4 three routes relocate session transcripts, in the documented precedence order `--session-dir`, then `PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR`, then the `sessionDir` setting. The command-line and environment routes are supplied at launch, so an external user-local state root is reachable without writing an absolute user path into committed configuration.
